raw_findings.source: p_ctx->tracks_num read from stream state / track parsing without upper bound validation before array indexing
raw_findings.evidence: If p_ctx->tracks_num reaches MP4_TRACKS_MAX (16), the check 'if(p_ctx->tracks_num >= MP4_TRACKS_MAX) return VC_CONTAINER_ERROR_OUT_OF_RESOURCES;' protects it, but in mp4_read_box_hdlr and elsewhere, track indices are indexed directly using module->current_track without robust bounds check against MP4_TRACKS_MAX.
p_ctx->tracks[module->current_track] is dereferenced without verifying that current_track is strictly less than p_ctx->tracks_num.
